description: Hand-authored synthetic campground, account and reservation records for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. No real facility, person or payment data.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records. Workflow rules modelled on Recreation.gov public help pages (15-minute cart hold, $10 change fee); the release schedule, refund ladders, cutoffs and alert effects are Switchback's own.
Recreation.gov Reservation Rules and Policies page, read for one modelled rule: a $10 change fee for switching to dates entirely outside the original reservation. No text, data or assets were copied.

collection.method: Read the public page in a browser-equivalent client

transformations: Fixed UTC-07:00 facility times; amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.
Rule modelled on the reference (source recgov-rules, accessed 2026-11-24T06:29:30Z): $10 change fee for a date or site change.

Switchback-defined rules: the 15-minute cart hold (the reference rules page does not state a hold time), the 180-day 07:00 release, the four-rung refund ladder and the 3-day/50% policy record, the 21:00 no-show release and 12:00 late-arrival release, the three-day refund posting, alert effects on stays and on the electric filter, and closures cancelling whole stays.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
